title: Smurfs The Lost Village
desc: In Smurfs: The Lost Village, Smurfette struggles to find her purpose as the only girl in the village. After discovering a mysterious map, she and her best friends-Hefty, Clumsy, and Brainy-defy Papa Smurf's rules to explore the Forbidden Forest. They race against the evil wizard Gargamel to find a fabled, hidden village.
